body.instruction: Use Inter for all body text, paragraphs, and functional UI elements.

accents.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-blue-400

gradients.text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 via-purple-400 to-cyan-400

grids.bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8

buttons.primary: relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all duration-300 rounded-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-glow focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-900
buttons.secondary: relative inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all duration-300 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 hover:scale-105 backdrop-blur-md

cards.base: rounded-3xl p-8 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:border-white/20 overflow-hidden relative group

inputs.base: w-full px-4 py-3 bg-slate-800/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none transition-all text-white placeholder-slate-400

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 20 -> 0) on page mount using Framer Motion.
motion.scroll_reveal: Elements should fade in and slide up when scrolling into view with a stagger effect (viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}).
motion.hover_effects: Cards tilt slightly, borders glow, buttons scale up by 1.05.
motion.parallax: Hero section text and background shapes move at different speeds on scroll.
motion.kinetic_typography: Masked line-by-line reveal for hero headings (overflow-hidden, child animates y: 100% -> 0).
motion.cursor: Custom glowing dot cursor that follows mouse, expands over interactive elements.
motion.magnetic: CTAs and header links attract cursor slightly.

hero.layout: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
hero.visuals: Animated gradient background (dark base with subtle moving blue/purple/cyan blooms), floating particles (Framer motion or tsparticles), custom grid overlay.
hero.content: Kinetic text for Name and Tagline. Typing effect (using react-simple-typewriter or framer-motion) for 'I analyze data, build dashboards, automate workflows...'.
hero.actions: 3 Magnetic Buttons: View Projects (Primary), Download Resume (Secondary), Contact Me (Secondary).
hero.scroll_indicator: Mouse or chevron icon at bottom bouncing to indicate scroll.

about_me.content: Manifesto style, numbered chapters (01. Background, 02. Vision). Mention BCA, Data Analytics, BI/Automation/AI.
about_me.visuals: Slow editorial marquee passing through background with terms like 'DATA DRIVEN', 'INSIGHTS', 'AUTOMATION'.

skills.layout: Grid of categories (Programming, Analytics, Database, Visualization, Tools, Soft Skills).
skills.content: Animated progress bars for technical skills, floating 3D-like icons for tools.

experience.content: Business Analyst Intern, Data Analytics Intern (use placeholders for details). Reveal on scroll.

projects.interaction: Card tilt effect on hover, image scales up.

certifications.content: Cisco CyberOps Professional, IIT Kanpur Foundation of Cloud IoT Edge ML, Power BI Certification, Python Programming Certification.

education.layout: Minimalist horizontal or vertical timeline for BCA.

achievements.content: Projects Completed, Certifications, Internships, Technologies Learned.
achievements.interaction: Use react-countup to animate numbers from 0 when visible.

contact.form: Glassmorphism panel, floating labels, validation, glowing submit button.
contact.socials: GitHub, LinkedIn, Email icons with hover glow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Dark text on bright gradients, white text on dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like social links).

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
Wrap the entire application or root layout in a CustomCursor provider and Lenis provider.
For the Dark/Light toggle, default to Dark mode but implement the logic using standard Tailwind dark mode class strategy.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids and negative space aggressively.
Use framer-motion extensively for scroll reveals and layout transitions.
Ensure every form field and button has a unique `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="contact-submit-button"`).
Implement the navbar as a sticky header with glassmorphism, active section highlighting using IntersectionObserver, and ensure it does not use a fully transparent background.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.avoid_ai_slop: Do not produce generic, centered, flat designs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Apply generous paddings like p-8, p-12.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.transitions: NEVER use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.alignment: DO NOT center align the entire app container. Left-align dense content.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Do NOT use emojis as UI icons.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
